mapper.select: SELECT cb.id AS id, cb.board_name AS title, IFNULL(cb.description, '') AS description, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM content_post p WHERE p.board_id = cb.id AND p.publish_status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.visibility = 1 ) AS threads, '' AS tone FROM content_board cb WHERE cb.status = 1 ORDER BY cb.sort ASC, cb.id ASC
